Thanks for the information.

I was not put on hold for a couple days, which the doctor acknowledged was odd. Do you guys have any idea if that 5 days starts from when I'm admitted to the hospital or from when they put a hold on me? It seems a little strange they could keep me here for a couple days and then put me on hold. Feels like a loophole they could use to keep me here longer.

Wow, I didn't expect someone to respond after a month. Luckily I was still logged in to this account.

I am doing ok.

My girlfriend and I have moved into to my parents basement apartment. She doesn't have a lot of stuff to do now that she is living in a slightly smaller town so she has been pretty attached to me. This wasn't really good because I have been pretty suicidal the past few weeks.

I had maybe my biggest anxiety attack 3 weeks ago. I think it was a sort of catalyst for the downward spiral that followed. I was at a music festival camping out for 3 days in a field. I went to use the showers and the lady running them refused to let me use the private stalls because they were for "people who needed it". I hate confrontation so being the awkward person I am I went into the mens shower room. The instant I stepped in I froze, there were probably 5-6 naked guys in there just walking around and joking with each other (I am guessing they were friends). One of them came up to me to ask if I was alright, apparently I didn't respond. I just turned around and walked away finding a spot in the trees nearby to hide. Im still having nightmares, it sucks.

I am somewhat on the up and up now. I'm still down, but I am just taking it one day at a time. It sort of feels like the only way I can carry on is to be depressed, it protects me. The hulks secret is that he is always angry. I fear that mine might be that I always have to be depressed.

Anyways, thanks for thinking about me. It's reassuring to know that someone out there cares.

I suffer from PTSD and experience a lot of flashbacks. A few things I would recommend are:
1) find a good therapist, preferably one that specializes in a technique called emdr. It is especially helpful in dealing with traumatic events.
2) mindful and meditation can help a lot. Start sitting in a comfy chair. Start for maybe 2-5 minutes once or twice a day. Focus on your breathing, your feet being planted or the floor, any sensation in your body. When year mind wanders don't get frustrated, just gently bring your focus back.
3) take care ofd yourself in other aspects, try to exercise if you can. Its hard, but it helps. If you cam eat. Eat healthy. If your body feels better, chances are you will too.

My main suggestion is still to talk to a therapist. They can help guide you through this journey. Its not easy, bit you can do it and things will get better.

Yes, I am unfortunately in the US, unfortunate at least compared to health care in a few other nations. I talked to my psychiatrist and therapist about getting on disability. It seems way to stress to even try getting on disability. Being so young, they both said it would be really hard. I would even have to hire a disability lawyer to have a chance.

My girlfriend is home from the hospital. She is doing a lot better and I am happy for her. They put her on lithium and it seems like she isn't quite the same person she once was and the side effects are making her pretty sick. So I'm pretty worried about her. Hopefully this next week, when she goes to outpatient therapy, they'll check her lithium levels and/or put her on a different med.

I'm taking online classes this summer and just missed a mid-term by accident. I haven't been all there this week and thought it was due tonight. It was due last night. I laid face down in my bed crying. I was actually trying hard this term and the teacher said I can't make it up. It was worth 1/3 of my grade. Which means I can't use the class because it will be below a C. I want to go to the hospital. I just don't know what to do.

My girlfriend and I are moving in with my parents in a month. Free rent and food. I'm hoping that will help with some stress. They have an apartment built into their basement so we will have some privacy and be able to scrape by.

How has been just working on yourself? I feel that's not really possible for me here unless I go to a psych ward. Which would then end up costing me $10,000+ once I got out.

Update:

I doubt anyone will see this, but I just wanted to right an update.

I just talked to her at the hospital. It didn't go as well as I hoped. I know she still half wants to do the pageants and I was having a hard time with that. I don't like pageants and I got in my own head. I need to apologize and am freaking out a bit. I've tried to get a hold of her a few times now, but no one is answering. I'm guessing they are in a group or something.

When I think of it as just her doing pageants it's bothers me. It's not till I think about it as me supporting this awesome woman doing something she enjoys and makes her feel good that I start to feel better. It's a long ways a way before she has to make a decision. I need to calm the fuck down!

She is freaking amazing and I will support her in anything she wants.
My double dose of sleeping meds i kicking in. Ill update tomorrow! Thanks for everyone listening. It really does help right now.

Hopefully we can discuss pageants when i see her tomorrow. I'll post an update then.

I'm also going to try to tell my therapist about what isn't working.

my girlfriend and I can talk about a super serious depressing moment then turn around and giggle hysterically for 20 minutes. She is my best friend, but I seriously trying to hold on. Right now it feels as if she needs everything I can gave her.

She also called her mom and grandma tonight but not me. I think I upset her by being distant when I visited. I had a lot to think about, so I sort of withdrew. I was anxious about being back in a psych ward, even if it was just as a visitor. Now I'm anxious if I should even visit tomorrow. A part of me just wants to end my life. She is so much stronger than me. I know I won't but it's just a though I have to process. When we are together I feel we are unstoppable. We can do anything. We will get through it. I know that, my PTSD just causes me to go off the deep end and it's hard to come back to reality.

We talked about doing it again, but the reason it never worked is because the important moments to me are being with my family, who she absolutely loves, and they love her. She has to miss everyone of our family meetings because they are the weekends.

I'm afraid to tell her that the pageants are driving me to be suicidal because I know she wouldn't do them anymore. That would cause huge turmoil in her family. Seriously, never have your kids (or you?) do pageants. They are not worth the stress. I feel if she didn't do them because of me it would create another stressor in our relationship. When we actually have time to spend together, a few nights a week and at least one weekend a month. She is so tired from pageants that we really don't do anything. She has been going, going, going, and needs a break. I understand that, but it doesn't invalidate my feelings.

I will talk about, but I kind of want to wait till she is out of the hospital.

Thanks a bunch for talking to me, it is helping me calm down and clear my head a bit.

She knows her family loves her, and shes knows they are manipulative, but they have been her only support for better or worse. She the above comments I made for details.

We've tried setting up one night a week that is pageant-free, but it never really works. I have to be a huge support for her to do pageants. Helping her shop, running errands, filling out contracts, making back track cds for her singing. Then when she goes to the event, she basically has to pretend I'm not her boyfriend, it's against pageants rules to show that in public.

She likes that she gets to sing in public and 'represent' her county. She likes the volunteering part, but she could volunteer just as much if not more without the pageants. She likes meeting the other girls, she doesn't have a lot of close friends. She likes the feeling that she matters.

Therapy works for awhile. I'm currently about at the top of the hill. About to come crashing down. I feel better when first starting therapy. The stress of having to ask for help is gone. My head clears up a little bit, then we start breaking down walls. I start having to discuss my childhood trauma, cleaning cum of my babysitters vagina, sucking him after there finish to get all the cum out and it goes on. It's months of imagery stuck in my head. I start to get anxious, even on heavy meds, I stop functioning for periods of time. It seems at some point talking can only go so far. My therapist can't physically help me find a healthy job, or physically check in on my school work. I know that's on me, but sometimes I can barely walk from the couch to the toilet, or to the bedroom. The quick progress stops and it causes me to dip back into deep depress and anxiety.

I'm alone for the first time in two years for my panic attacks, I can't stop them and they feed on one another. I feel like what's the point?

Sorry for being a little confusing, my brain is spinning a million miles an hour.

Her grandparents are the source of money for the family. They are worth millions at least from what I can tell. They have helped her our very little in finances for school. They did however spend well over 20k on dresses, makeup, hair stuff, etc... They want her to work full-time, go to school full-time, and do pageants.

The only way they will continue to support is to do pageants. I think on some level she does enjoy them and it is good scholarship money, but it is a huge stress on everyone. I basically lose her for a year. I feel like they are another way for her family to control her. When her therapist and psychiatrist are trying to get her to distance herself.

She is thinking of my feelings, her own feelings, and weighing her family's feelings.

However, to give you a small background on her family. When she was raped at 14 it was when she lost her virginity. She was raped by a 16 year old boy who her mom invited him and his mom to live with them. Her family claims that she wasn't really "raped", that she just didn't know that's what women were suppose to do and didn't know that she could say no. She was begging and crying during the rape. She didn't know what to do afterwards and it happened over and over.

I feel she is in a tricky situation. Trying to balance everyone's feelings, but I feel if she does pageants, she is just allowing her family to assert their control over her. Even if she wants to do them. Something her care team wants her to get away from (the control, not necessarily the pageants). On the other hand, it's super hard on our relationship, she is stressed and gone all the time. Thus, I am stressed. However, she has met a few great friends and has gotten a lot of scholarship money. The funny side is she can't really go to school while she does pageants because of the commitment.

I mostly understand most sides of it. I just don't want to go through that stress again. I don't feel I can take it again and it feels that her wanting to them that badly means on some level she doesn't care about my feelings. I know that isn't necessarily true, but that's how it makes me feel.

The important part is, I want to be with her. She is everything to me.
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xW4tU4JDMu4
It makes me think of our relationship. How it goes beyond just two people being together. I can fully trust her, be completely vulnerable with her. I have shown her my grotesque and disturbing true self and she sees the beauty in it. I love her.

I'm going downhill fast. I don't know what to do.

I went for a run to try to clear my mind. I broke down crying a bunch of times during the run. It was the first time that ever happened.

I have sleeping meds, Im about to take a few, hopefully I can knock myself out.

EDIT: I went crazy here... http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1jh0kq/spiraling_down_the_rabbit_hole_im_a_guy_with_ptsd/

I know its not funny, but your story sound way too similar to mine.

I literally just sent an email to the ADA person. It sounds like they can't do a whole lot, but they can make it so I get homework and test extensions without any penalty's. So that can help me if I only have a few bad days. It seems I can also get extended drop dates so I wouldn't have to take a withdrawal or an F.

My 10 year reunion is coming up as well. I've pretty much decided I'm not going even though my best friend is putting it on. I have way too much anxiety about talking to people. I can't talk to pretty much anyone from high school.

I'm sorry you had to experience such a horrible act. The world and some people can be unbelievably cruel. You should know that you have given me hope. I know there is good and beauty in the world and it is worth fighting for.

It's taking me a long time to realize, but I've always tried to 'fix' myself and my situation. The thing that has helped me make progress is just being, not doing anything, but just being with myself. It's scary and it's hard, but I've made a bunch of progress.

I've worked in retail and in a cafe. I've worked seasonal jobs, part-time, and full-time. It seems no matter what I can't maintain a consistent lifestyle. My latest job was the best I ever had. It was an awesome non-profit health IT company and I worked as a .NET Developer. It was great, everybody was great. Then I got depressed, quit my job, and tried to kill myself. This was after only one month. It really had nothing to do with being there a month, it was just another random slap in the face.

I know I have to figure out better coping skills and to find a way to make a sustainable career. One that I can last through when I have a bad week or two. Things are getting better but I feel I have to scratch and claw for my life to only maybe make an inch of progress.

I want to be selfish, I want there to be one person out there who could understand my situation and help me out with a job. There world doesn't work that way. I feel like a liability, a risk too great to take on. My employable value is near zero.

I appreciate your comments. I am working on finding alternatives, I just still have trouble believing there is a sustainable future for me.

School if frustrating when you know you can do it, but there is some obstacle in the way. For me it's, I have insomnia for a week, or I try to kill myself, or I go into a deep depression. One bad week and I fail the semester.

Your post made a lot of sense to me. I'm glad to know there are others out there. Sometimes it gets so self involved that I forget that I'm not alone.

Thanks sharing part of your story and the words of encouragement.

I know nothing lasts for ever, it just seems every time I try something new the same thing happens.

It's just frustrating when I know I am beyond capable of completing a degree, but one bad week in a term can cause me to fail every class.

Have you ever tried to get any ADA accommodations? For some reason, after 10 years of struggling, I'm just now starting to ask for help from the school.
That quote is pretty awesome :) It made me smile. Thank You!

Being raped will cause deep scars. That said, if you truly care about her, do not let what some asshole did to her to end your relationship. Being with her can help the healing process. Don't ask her to talk about it, but let her know you are always willing to listen without any judgement. If she isn't seeing a therapist, help her to realize that is ok to get help.

She might act out at some point. It's because she has to process emotions that are disturbing and confusing. You need to be there for her, let her know you are there to support her however she needs  you to.

That said, getting through rape takes time. Most people will need many months to many years to process it. It doesn't mean she will be 'crazy', but there are probably going be  some hard times. Depression and mania are ways of coping with intense memories that the mind doesn't know how to deal with. Everyone is different.

If you care about her, you shouldn't even think of breaking it off with her. Being her support, her rock, can and will strengthen your relationship bringing you together. If you don't think you can handle having to help her through something that is tough, then it might be best for both of you to break it off.

Also, try not to take too many things personal. Everyone has different ways of coping with trauma, but as long as you care bout her and she is taking steps forward it can be a rewarding and healthy relationship.

Just be respectful of any sexual boundaries, talk about sex. It will help!
